system.story: The fortress - earth and void raised as walls, pits, and warding.

description.value:
Subclass: Geomancer (Earth & Void - terrain & defense). The fortress: the toughest, most defensive Elementalist and the strongest terrain-denial.

Role Feature - Standing Stone

Favors acid/corruption and terrain shaping - walls, difficult ground, pillars, pits, and warding. When you raise terrain you also shield yourself or an ally (a small stability/defense rider).

Signature Summon

An earth/void elemental - durable: a brute or a warper.

Corp Records

Geo-structural / spatial specialist.
